derivation_note: musid-dli Track wire shape (pinned by musid-dli models/track.rs legacy+round-trip tests). Sample values from the musid-dli source_kugou.rs inline parse test parses_kg_search_items_and_grp_variants (source_kugou.rs:2299-2336). Provenance (stated honestly): upstream musid-dli has NO committed search-shape fixture for kugou — tests/fixtures/kugou/ carries sign/KRC/category/link/login files only — so this is a RECONSTRUCTED wire shape over the crate's own pinned parse values (Audioid 123456 / 晴天 / 周杰伦 / 叶惠美 / AlbumID 42 / Duration 269 / FileSize 4312832 + HQFileSize 10781692 + SQFileSize 0 + ResFileSize 12345678 / FileHash ABCDEF0123 + HQFileHash HQ0123). available_qualities [Low, High, HiRes] (SQFileSize 0 → no Lossless) folds to {Low128, High320, Flac24}, identical to the legacy kg/search.rs parse_song set. extra carries the hash keys (FileHash/HQFileHash; SQFileHash absent, ResFileHash not in the pinned item) and the size keys (>0 only) — the resolve face reads them back via select_hash (source_kugou.rs:519-536).
